title: Validity of smartwatch-derived estimates of lactate threshold heart rate and pace compared to graded exercise testing
claims: One hundred healthy recreational runners underwent indoor graded exercise tests and outdoor smartwatch tests.
The success rate for a single test was 78% for Huawei, 65.22% for Garmin and 47.06% for Coros.
For lactate threshold heart rate, mean absolute percentage errors were 6.32% (Huawei), 7.15% (Garmin) and 5.95% (Coros).
All three devices overestimated lactate-threshold pace, with MAPE 12.70% (Huawei), 25.78% (Garmin) and 22.63% (Coros); the Coros difference was not significant (p = 0.08).
Correlations for threshold heart rate ranged from r = 0.13 to 0.67, and R-squared values ranged from 0.02 to 0.45.
The authors concluded that smartwatches can provide estimates in recreational runners but that accuracy still needs improvement.

verification.note: Frontiers in Physiology 正式论文（2025-07-04），非预印本；该文于 2025-07-16 发布更正（Front Physiol 16:1661421）。读到摘要、方法与设计部分。

claimVerification.note: 原文：“One hundred healthy recreational runners underwent indoor graded exercise tests followed by outdoor tests using Huawei (n = 100), Garmin (n = 23), and Coros (n = 17)”。注意各设备子样本量不同，非每人均测三块表。
摘要原文：“The success rates for a single test were 78% for Huawei®, 65.22% for Garmin®, and 47.06% for Coros®.”
摘要原文：“The Huawei® watch showed MAE = 10.66 bpm, MAPE = 6.32%; Garmin®: MAE = 11.44 bpm, MAPE = 7.15%; Coros®: MAE = 8.93 bpm, MAPE = 5.95%.”
摘要称 “significant overestimation for all devices”，但同段 Coros p = 0.08；MAPE 12.70%/25.78%/22.63% 与原文一致，已改为“均高估、Coros 未达显著”。
摘要原文：“Corresponding Pearson correlation coefficients ranged from r = 0.13 to 0.67, and R2 values ranged from 0.02 to 0.45.”指 LT HR。
结论原文：“Smartwatches are capable of providing estimates of LT HR and LT Pace in recreational runners, although they tend to overestimate LT Pace and overall accuracy remains to be improved.”
